title: Blends Assessment Image Request
globalRequirements: Export one WebP image per request at the exact outputPath.
Do not include printed words, letters, captions, signs, labels, speech bubbles, UI elements, or watermarks.
Images should be clear enough for K-2 students to identify the word without revealing any blend text.

images.visualDescription: children acting on a small classroom stage
images.prompt: Create a bright, child-safe literacy assessment illustration showing children acting on a small classroom stage. Do not include printed words, letters, captions, signs, labels, speech bubbles, or UI elements. Use a clean classroom-reader style, simple background, warm natural colors, clear object/action focus, and a 4:3 landscape composition.
